questions.prompt:
What does Mr. Bird like?
伯德先生喜欢什么？
questions.answer: Mr. Bird likes steak.

lines.speaker: BUTCHER
lines.text: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?
lines.translation: 您今天要买点肉吗，伯德夫人？

lines.speaker: BUTCHER
lines.text: Do you want beef or lamb?
lines.translation: 您要牛肉还是要羔羊肉？

lines.speaker: MRS. BIRD
lines.text: I like lamb, but my husband doesn’t.
lines.translation: 我喜欢羔羊肉，可我丈夫不喜欢。

lines.speaker: BUTCHER
lines.text: What about some steak? This is a nice piece.

lines.speaker: MRS. BIRD
lines.text: And a pound of mince, too.

lines.speaker: BUTCHER
lines.text: Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird? They’re very nice.
lines.translation: 您要买只鸡吗，伯德夫人？这些鸡很好。

lines.speaker: MRS. BIRD
lines.text: My husband likes steak, but he doesn’t like chicken.
lines.translation: 我丈夫喜欢牛排，但他不喜欢鸡。

lines.speaker: BUTCHER
lines.text: To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird, I don’t like chicken either!
lines.translation: 说老实话，伯德夫人，我也不喜欢鸡。

items.title: 1 Do you want beef or lamb?
items.text: 是选择疑问句，本句有两项选择，第一选择 beef 念升调，lamb 则读降调。

items.title: 2 I like lamb, but my husband doesn’t.
items.text: 句中的 doesn’t 后面省略了 like lamb。用 but 连接的并列句，在后一分句中可以省略与前一分句中相同的谓语动词和宾语。

items.title: 3 To tell you the truth
items.text: To tell you the truth（或 To tell the truth），意思是：“老实说”，“说实话”。

items.title: 4 I don’t like chicken either.
items.text: either 当“也（不）”讲，用在否定句中。肯定句和疑问句中可用 too，在第 7 课和第 31 课中已出现过这样的句子。

practice.title: A Dialogue
practice.instruction: Read this dialogue. Fill in the missing words.
practice.context: Complete each speaker’s turn. Give missing words in blank order.

questions.prompt: Butcher: ____ you want ____ or lamb today, Mrs. Bird?
questions.answer: Do; beef

questions.prompt: Mrs. Bird: Beef, ____.
questions.answer: please

questions.prompt: Butcher: ____ lamb’s very good.
questions.answer: The

questions.prompt: Mrs. Bird: Well, I like ____, but my husband ____.
questions.answer: lamb; doesn’t

questions.prompt: Butcher: How ____ ____ steak? This is ____ nice ____.
questions.answer: about; some; a; piece

questions.prompt: Mrs. Bird: Yes, ____ me that piece. My husband ____ steak.
questions.answer: give; likes
